evidence: Carries the Wallet label, edits `src/wallet/wallet.cpp` rebroadcast logic, and refactors `wallet_resendwallettransactions.py`.
rationale: Mitigates a long-standing wallet transaction origin and IP privacy leak caused by unconditional periodic rebroadcasts of transactions already retained in the local mempool. Addressing transaction rebroadcast fingerprinting provides substantial, durable privacy value for wallet users.
